title: PlanSightRAG: A Visual-First Multimodal RAG for Automating Question Answering and Compliance Checking for Civil Standard Plans
abstract: arXiv:2608.26091v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Civil infrastructure compliance checking has long relied on engineers manually reading legacy 2D plans; however, OCR-based automation strips away the geometry and layout essential for interpreting these plans. We present a Visual-First Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework called PlanSightRAG. It indexes and reasons directly over plan imagery, integrates a ColNomic-3B multi-vector retrieval, an agentic Planner-Retriever-Auditor-Synthesizer, and MaxSim heatmaps as an evidence trail. We introduce a 4,056-pair benchmark from five state Departments of Transportation (DOT) standard plans (1,898 pages). PlanSightRAG achieves 91.47% Recall@5 on zero-shot retrieval, while on a held-out Michigan DOT corpus, it achieves 91.40%. translated_title: PlanSightRAG：一种面向土木标准图纸自动问答与合规检查的视觉优先多模态RAG框架
translated_abstract: 土木基础设施合规检查长期以来依赖工程师手动阅读传统的二维图纸；然而，基于OCR的自动化方法剥离了解读这些图纸所必需的几何与布局信息。我们提出了一种名为PlanSightRAG的视觉优先多模态检索增强生成（RAG）框架。它直接在图纸图像上进行索引和推理，集成了ColNomic-3B多向量检索、一个智能体化的规划器-检索器-审计器-合成器，以及MaxSim热力图作为证据线索。我们引入了来自五个州交通部（DOT）标准图纸（共1,898页）的4,056对基准数据集。PlanSightRAG在零样本检索上实现了91.47%的Recall@5，而在一个保留的密歇根州交通部语料库上达到了91.40%。在合成、参数生成的合规图纸上，我们的Qwen2.5-VL-72B流水线仅在提供预解析规则阈值时达到100%的判定准确率，这是一个受控上限，而一个非视觉方法则无法达到。
tldr: 本文提出了一种直接基于图纸图像进行索引和推理的视觉优先多模态RAG框架PlanSightRAG，通过集成多向量检索和智能体流程，在零样本检索和合规检查中实现了高准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper presents PlanSightRAG, a visual-first multimodal RAG framework that indexes and reasons directly over plan imagery, achieving high recall in zero-shot retrieval and compliance checking through integrated multi-vector retrieval and agentic workflows.
